competences.description: Attacks all enemies to freeze for 2 turns.

Grants a Shield equal to 5% of the boss's MAX HP on itself for 2 turns, and then attacks all enemies 3 times. Each hit inflicts Continuous Damage for 2 turns with a 50% chance on enemies with no harmful effects. Gains 1 stack of Chaos Force whenever attacking a frozen enemy.
Attacks all enemies. Gains 5 stacks of Chaos Force if the boss's HP is at 50% or above. When attacking frozen enemies, Chaos Force increases by the number of those enemies.

Decreases the HP of all enemies by 1% per stack of Chaos Force, and then attacks all enemies. The damage dealt increases by 1% per stack of Chaos Force. This attack does not activate passive skills of the enemies.
